blockingFindings.rootCause: The socket treats a reconnect token as identity authority while generation, issuance and projection make that token available without proving identity.
blockingFindings.impact: Spectator can become the seated host/controller, expose that controller's private projection and issue real B11/Golden Eater mutations. Fixed socket lifecycle races do not repair authentication.
minimalRepair: Split public RoomClient DTO from server-private reconnect credentials; exclude all credentials from other-viewer HTTP/WS projections and broadcast.
Generate unpredictable server-owned credentials using cryptographic randomness; handle legacy persisted credentials explicitly rather than silently retaining predictable tokens.
Reject duplicate clientId joins unless an authenticated reconnect flow proves existing credentials; do not grant existing host identity by clientId alone.
Read private credential state for socket authentication; do not depend on a public projection containing secrets.

Regression: spectator projection, duplicate host join, deterministic old-token guess and raw WS host impersonation must reject without changing state/revision/logs/version; genuine reconnect must remain functional.

evidence.fact: Missing revision returns successfully when required=false.
Raw client:end_turn reaches optional Hub gate.

blockingFindings.rootCause: Mutation commands have inconsistent authoritative freshness requirements; a raw WS caller can bypass the revision check used by ordinary dispatch.
blockingFindings.impact: Omitting revision advances the battle phase and runs server settlement. The reproduced command changed revision 2->8, phase battle->round_end, logs 19->39, room version 2->3 with no error.
minimalRepair: Require numeric expectedRevision for end_turn in protocol and Hub, and reject missing/invalid/mismatched revision before any mutation.
Use one required mutation gate for dispatch/end-turn; bump room version/broadcast accepted mutation only after successful result.

Add raw WS and direct Hub missing/stale revision negatives for both commands; assert GameState, pending, resource values, events, logs, revision, room version and projection unchanged after rejection.
